newsitem.title: USA: NYSE suspends trade in Orchard Supply.
newsitem.headline: NYSE suspends trade in Orchard Supply.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Thursday it had suspended trading in the common stock of Orchard Supply Hardware Stores Corp with the intention of eventually delisting it.
The exchange said it would submit an application to the Securities and Exchange Commission to delist the stock.

"The NYSE ... normally considers suspending and removing from its lists the securities of a company when fewer than 600,000 common shares are held by the public," it said in a statement. " As a result of a tender offer by Sears, Roebuck and Co which expired at 12:00 midnight on September 18, 1996, fewer than 600,000 common shares remain publicly held."

Earlier Thursday, Sears, Roebuck and Co said it had completed a $35 a share tender offer for the outstanding common shares of Orchard, adding that about 8,705,203 shares or about 98.67 percent of them were tendered.
